公司簡介
Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中     China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及        integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business spans across
保健產品的生產、分銷及零售。本集團成立於        manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前五大醫藥製造        products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into one
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。本       of the fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and the one of the third
公司於二零一六年十月在香港成功完成全球發        largest pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China. In October 2016,
售以來，已被納入摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI)     the Company successfully completed its global offering in Hong Kong. Since
中國指數、富時全球股票指數（大型股）、恒生       its listing, the Company has been included in a number of capital market
綜合大型股指數成份股、恒生可持續發展企業        indexes such as MSCI China Index, FTSE Global Large Cap Index, constituent
基準指數等多項資本市場指數，反映了國際資        stock of Hang Seng Composite Large Cap Index and Hang Seng Corporate
本市場對本集團經營業績、發展潛力、市值、        Sustainability Index, reflecting a global recognition by the international capital
以及股份流動性的全方位肯定。              markets on the Group’s business performance, growth potential, market
                            capitalization, and share liquidity.

我們的製造業務涵蓋研發、生產及銷售醫藥產        Our manufacturing business encompasses the research and development,
品。我們生產超過540種藥品，產品組合包括       manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products. We manufacture more
化學藥品、中藥、生物製劑以及營養保健品，        than 540 products comprising chemical drugs, Chinese medicines and
覆蓋廣泛治療領域，包括心血管、消化道和新        biopharmaceutical drugs as well as nutritional and healthcare products,
陳代謝、大容量靜脈注射液、兒科、呼吸系         covering a wide range of therapeutic areas including cardiovascular,
統等。此外，我們擁有多個馳名品牌，包括         alimentary tract and metabolism, large-volume IV infusion, pediatrics,
「999」、「東阿阿膠」、「雙鶴」、「紫竹」及「江   respiratory system etc.. Besides, we own a series of strong, well-known brands
中」。                         including “999”, “Dong-E-E-Jiao (東阿阿膠)”, “Double-Crane (雙鶴)”, “Zizhu
                            (紫竹)”, and “Jiangzhong (江中)“.

我們經營著一個由178個物流中心構成的全國       We operate a national distribution network comprising 178 logistics centers
性分銷網絡，戰略性覆蓋中國28個省、直轄市       strategically across 28 provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions in
及自治區。憑藉我們全面的產品供應及廣泛的        China. Leveraging our comprehensive product portfolio and wide distribution
分銷網絡，我們向中國醫院及其他醫療機構直        networks, we directly distribute products to hospitals and other medical
接分銷產品。另外，我們經營中國最大零售藥        institutions across the country. In addition, we operate one of the largest retail
房網絡之一，我們以「華潤堂」和「德信行」等全      pharmacy networks in China, comprising over 850 pharmacies under national
國或地區性的優質品牌來經營超過850家零售       or regional premium brands — “CR Care (華潤堂)”, and “Teck Soon Hong (德

內部監控及風險管理                  INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT
董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管理      The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board
及內部監控制度，以保障股東的投資及本公司的      for maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control
資產，並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險管理及      systems to safeguard shareholder investments and Company assets and
內部監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失提供合理      reviewing the effectiveness of such systems on an annual basis. The risk
而非絕對的保證，並旨在管理而非消除在達致業      management and internal control systems can provide reasonable and
務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。            not absolute assurance against material misstatement or loss, and are
                           designed to manage rather than eliminate the risk of failure in the process
                           of attaining business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系統，      The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and
並極為重視其製藥、醫藥分銷及藥品零售業務的      internal control system, and devoted significant attention to internal
內部控制措施。其已採取嚴格的內部控制措施及      control measures of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical
經營程式，以監管從研發到生產、分銷及零售的      distribution and pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent
醫藥價值鏈各個環節。本集團內部控制系統根       internal control measures and operating procedures to regulate all stages
據相關行業及管理標準（包括GMP及GSP要求）設   of its pharmaceutical value chain, from research and development to
計。本集團定期實施內部控制審計、內部風險管      manufacturing, distribution and retail. The Group’s internal control system
理及除錯防錯方面的各項程序。             is designed according to relevant industrial and management standards,
                           including the GMP and GSP requirements. The Group implements the
                           procedures for periodic internal control audit, internal risk management,
                           and error correction and prevention on a regular basis.

   貸提升措施。                             or other credit enhancements that are integral to the contractual

   一般方法                              General approach
   預期信貸虧損分兩個階段進行確認。就自初                ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit exposures for which
   始確認起信貸風險並無大幅增加的信貸敞                 there has not been a significant increase in credit risk since initial
   口而言，會就未來12個月內可能發生違約                recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result from
   事件而導致的信貸虧損（12個月預期信貸虧               default events that are possible within the next 12 months (a
   損）計提預期信貸虧損。就自初始確認起信                12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which there has been
   貸風險大幅增加的該等信貸敞口而言，不論                a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition, a loss
   何時發生違約，於敞口的餘下年期內的預期                allowance is required for credit losses expected over the remaining
   信貸虧損均須計提虧損撥備（全期預期信貸                life of the exposure, irrespective of the timing of the default (a
   虧損）。                               lifetime ECL).

      資產的部分成本。當資產已大致可作擬定用                   use or sale, are capitalised as part of the cost of those assets. The
      途或出售時，則不會再將該等借款成本撥充                   capitalisation of such borrowing costs ceases when the assets
      資本。在特定借款用作合資格資產支出前暫                   are substantially ready for their intended use or sale. Investment
      作投資所賺取的投資收入須自撥充資本的借                   income earned on the temporary investment of specific borrowings
      款成本扣除。所有其他借款成本於產生期間                   pending their expenditure on qualifying assets is deducted from the
      支銷。借款成本包括一間實體借款時產生的                   borrowing costs capitalised. All other borrowing costs are expensed
      利息及其他成本。                              in the period in which they are incurred. Borrowing costs consist of

      之資產，而以類似抵押品與類似期間借入所                  similar security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar

      反映了本集團「應支付」的利率，當無可觀察                 The IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would have to

      司而言）或當須對利率進行調整以反映租賃                  available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter into financing

      之功能貨幣訂立時），則須作出利率估計。                  and conditions of the lease (for example, when leases are not in the
      當可觀察輸入數據可用時，本集團使用可觀                  subsidiary’s functional currency). The Group estimates the IBR using
      察輸入數據（如市場利率）估算增量借款利率                 observable inputs (such as market interest rates) when available and
      並須作出若干實體特定的估計（如附屬公司                  is required to make certain entity-specific estimates (such as the

40. 或然負債                                 40. CONTINGENT LIABILITIES
      於截至二零一九年及二零一八年十二月                       During the years ended 31 December 2019 and 2018, the Group
      三十一日止年度，本集團(i)背書若干應收票                   (i) endorsed certain bills receivable for the settlement of trade and
      據以結算貿易及其他應付款項；及(ii)向銀行                  other payables; and (ii) discounted certain bills receivable to banks
      貼現若干應收票據以籌集現金。本公司董事                     for raising cash. In the opinion of the directors of the Company,
      認為，本集團已將與該等應收票據有關的重                     the Group has transferred the significant risks and rewards
      大風險及回報轉移，且按照中國的商業慣                      relating to these bills receivable, and the Group’s obligations to
